title: Lazar said in 1989 that the craft were intact and the Navy was in charge

tellings.quote: Bob Lazar comes out in 1989 and says they weren't crash saucers, they were intact craft. And it's the Navy that's in charge.

plain: Luigi Vendetelli, a researcher, says that when Bob Lazar went public in 1989 about working at S4, a secret site in Nevada, his story broke from the usual one. According to Vendetelli, Lazar said the craft were not crashed saucers but intact ones, and that the Navy, not the Air Force that had run Project Blue Book, its UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, was in charge. If true, it would change who has been holding the secret and what they have.
